name: Neuron (Multipolar Motor Nerve Cell)
semanticDescription: High-fidelity multipolar motor neuron model featuring soma (cell body) with nucleus and nucleolus, radiating branching dendrites, axon hillock, elongated axon core, cylindrical Schwann cell myelin sheaths with Nodes of Ranvier, and terminal telodendria arborization with synaptic boutons (CBSE Class 10 Biology Ch 7 Figure 7.1; CBSE Class 11 Biology Ch 21 Figure 21.1).
simplifications: Dendritic arbor simplified to primary and secondary branches for educational clarity.
Myelin sheath modeled as segmented cylindrical Schwann cells with distinct Nodes of Ranvier.

materials.look: Warm amber neuronal cell body cytoplasm
Blue conducting central axonal core fiber
Ivory white concentric cylindrical Schwann cell insulating sheaths
Prominent spherical nucleus with dark nucleolus
